matchstick.title: Balance by numeric difference and single‑stick transformation
matchstick.principle: Compute the integer values of both sides, find the numeric difference, and then search for a single‑stick relocation that changes the values by exactly that amount while keeping all symbols valid Roman numerals or operators.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Whenever the equation is false and exactly one matchstick may be moved.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick without checking the resulting numeric values, leaving the equation still unbalanced.

matchstick.title: Convert V to X to add 5
matchstick.principle: If the numeric imbalance is exactly 5 and a V appears, relocate one of V’s diagonal sticks so that the two diagonals intersect, turning the V into an X (value 10) and adding 5 to that numeral.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 5 and a V is present in the expression.
matchstick.example: Attempting to change V to X by moving a stick but destroying the V shape, resulting in an invalid numeral.

matchstick.title: Swap I and V in IV to make VI (adds 2)
matchstick.principle: When the imbalance is exactly 2 and the pattern IV appears, move the vertical stick of the I to the right side of the V, forming VI and increasing the value by 2.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 2 and an IV occurs.
matchstick.example: Moving the I stick incorrectly and creating an invalid numeral such as IIV.

matchstick.title: Change + to - and add I
matchstick.principle: If a plus sign is present and the numeric imbalance can be fixed by decreasing the right‑hand side and increasing a numeral by 1, remove the vertical stick from the ‘+’ (turning it into ‘‑’) and attach that stick as a new I to a numeral, raising its value by 1.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by a small amount (typically 1 or 2) and a ‘+’ appears, consider converting ‘+’ to ‘‑’ and using the removed stick to add an I.
matchstick.example: Moving the vertical stick from ‘+’ to a numeral but leaving the operator still as ‘+’, so the equation remains false.

matchstick.title: Transfer I stick between numerals
matchstick.principle: When the equation is off by 1 and there are isolated I’s, relocate a vertical stick from one I to another; this reduces the source numeral by 1 and increases the target numeral by 1, potentially balancing the equation.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the numeric difference is 1 and both sides contain separate I’s that can be split or combined.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from an I without adjusting the source numeral, leaving an invalid or incomplete numeral.
